heading: THE GREAT PYRAMID
detail: A locked monument, still full of questions
direction: Establish real modern exterior; no inferred hidden rooms
spoken_text: Think of the Great Pyramid, not as a postcard, but as a locked building. Its doors were sealed in antiquity. Its passages are steep and strangely arranged.

heading: A SPACE IN STONE
detail: Modern physics measures differences inside stone
direction: Draw conceptual internal passage and the unknown-space marker; not to scale
spoken_text: Behind its enormous walls, ancient builders left spaces that nobody alive can confidently explain. Now imagine discovering one of those spaces without breaking a single stone. That is what a team of scientists did, using particles that fall through our atmosphere.

heading: BELOW THE SURFACE
detail: The weight of limestone; a narrow surviving passage
direction: Draw close spatial framing of limestone corridor and overhead mass; schematic
spoken_text: We will get to their discovery, but first I want you to picture the uncomfortable silence inside a monument that has stood for about four and a half thousand years. The air feels still. The passage is narrow. Above your head rests an unimaginable weight of limestone.

heading: THE BIG VOID · 2017
detail: At least 30 metres; above the Grand Gallery
direction: Diagram concept; locational evidence, no claim about orientation or contents
spoken_text: In November twenty seventeen, an international research collaboration announced a finding inside Khufu's pyramid. They called it the Big Void. It is at least thirty metres long and sits above the Grand Gallery, one of the best-known internal passages.

heading: THREE INDEPENDENT TESTS
detail: Muon detectors revealed a density anomaly
direction: Show detectors positioned inside and outside structure, labelled conceptual
spoken_text: The evidence came from three independent kinds of cosmic-ray muon detectors. The instruments recorded a pattern that suggested less stone was present in one region than a solid pyramid would contain.

heading: WHAT WAS ACTUALLY FOUND
detail: Density anomaly: yes. Treasure photograph: no.
direction: Evidence-vs-claim hierarchy, no fantasy archaeological footage
spoken_text: This did not produce a photograph of a furnished room. Scientists detected an empty space indirectly, then checked that result with different equipment. That distinction is the difference between a scientific discovery and an imagined treasure chamber.

heading: OVER 30 METRES
detail: A measured length; not a photographed room
direction: Measured arrow in uncluttered pyramid section, not-to-scale disclosure
spoken_text: The size was startling. Picture a space comparable in length to a ten-storey building laid on its side, hidden inside a structure people had studied for centuries.

heading: THE PURPOSE IS UNKNOWN
detail: Construction and load-management ideas remain hypotheses
direction: Three hypothesis panels with question marks; avoid presenting inference as fact
spoken_text: But the purpose of that space remains unknown. Perhaps it relieved pressure during construction. Perhaps it formed part of a building sequence that was later sealed. Researchers have explored possibilities, but a measurement of emptiness does not explain a builder's intentions.

heading: NO CONFIRMED CONTENTS
detail: Gold, books and machines have not been discovered in the void
direction: No photographic claims; plain evidence-based matrix
spoken_text: No one should tell you that gold, a mummy, a library, or a machine has been found there. The muon measurements have not demonstrated any of those things.

heading: EXAMINED FOR CENTURIES
detail: Ancient monument. Modern investigation.
direction: Use authentic historical aerial image of the pyramids; label date unknown
spoken_text: One reason the discovery is so compelling is how recently we learned about it. The Great Pyramid is hardly an obscure ruin. Photographers, travellers, historians and archaeologists have examined it for generations.

heading: MEASURED · MAPPED · STUDIED
detail: A long history of examining internal architecture
direction: Original annotated study drawing with original labels (not a historic manuscript)
spoken_text: Its chambers have been measured repeatedly. Its stone has been mapped. Its proportions appear in countless books.

heading: NEW EVIDENCE IN OLD STONE
detail: Muon tomography revealed something mapping missed
direction: Show concept of cosmic particles passing through a stone density difference
spoken_text: And yet, when instruments looked for differences in density, the monument gave up another fact. Even an intensely visited landmark can still contain something genuinely new.

heading: THE PEOPLE OF GIZA
detail: Workers' settlements reveal food, organisation and daily life
direction: Original clean site-based settlement schematic, not photo of a specific dig
spoken_text: That has always been the rhythm of Egyptian archaeology. Each generation inherits a story that seems complete, then another piece of evidence changes the picture. A workers' settlement on the edge of Giza reveals kitchens and sleeping quarters.

heading: MERER'S WORK LOG
detail: Ancient papyri record limestone transport
direction: Original modern record graphic without invented hieroglyphs
spoken_text: A torn papyrus discovered on the Red Sea coast records limestone deliveries.

heading: A CHANGING NILE
detail: Buried channels reshape the picture of pyramid logistics
direction: Conceptual river route with explicit not-to-scale label; no false ancient map
spoken_text: A branch of the Nile, concealed beneath the modern landscape, appears in geophysical surveys. Each find answers a practical question while opening another. The pyramid's mystery is therefore not one question. It is a chain of questions about government, religion, mathematics, labour, transport and time.

heading: PEOPLE, NOT MYTHS
detail: The work belongs to ancient Egyptian society
direction: Depict schematic teams and labour rather than fantasy builders
spoken_text: We should also acknowledge the people at the centre of the story. The Great Pyramid was not built by a mythical race of engineers with secret machines.

heading: A CONNECTED SYSTEM
detail: Quarries → boats → food → worksite
direction: Four sequential original vector icons connected in an explanatory workflow
spoken_text: It was a royal project organised by a state whose people could quarry stone, move cargo, survey land, shape timber, build boats and feed large workforces. The surviving evidence does not provide every step of their method, and serious researchers disagree about some details.

heading: KNOWN CIVILISATION
detail: Khufu's era is historically established; details remain contested
direction: Fact-confidence ranking with labelled documentary evidence
spoken_text: But uncertainty about particular ramps is not the same as uncertainty about who lived in the Nile valley. We know the civilisation, the period, the king and a remarkable amount about the work.

heading: THE JOURNEY AHEAD
detail: Written records, archaeological remains and measured spaces
direction: Three focused evidence categories, no unsupported ancient artifacts
spoken_text: Over the course of this investigation, we'll follow the evidence from the desert surface into ancient workshops and through corridors within the pyramid. We'll learn what ancient Egyptian records actually say, how modern scientific detectors operate, why some viral claims fall apart, and where the next meaningful discovery could come from.

heading: EVIDENCE BEFORE THEORY
detail: Disagreement is not permission to invent discoveries
direction: Distinct visual tiers: measurement, inference, speculation
spoken_text: You will hear competing ideas when the sources support a real disagreement. Where evidence is absent, we will say so.

heading: THE REAL MYSTERY
detail: The unanswered question is the most interesting one
direction: Return to authentic Giza monument as transition to historical setting
spoken_text: Mystery is more rewarding when no one cheats on the answer.

heading: FACTS UNCOVERED
detail: Stories & Evidence
direction: Natural subscription invitation with restrained channel title
spoken_text: You're watching Facts Uncovered: Stories and Evidence. If you want historical mysteries investigated carefully, rather than explained away with sensational headlines, subscribe now and share this documentary with someone who loves ancient history.

heading: BEFORE THE VOID
detail: Khufu · Fourth Dynasty · Old Kingdom
direction: Verified historical chronological framing, no invented exact dates
spoken_text: Our first stop is not a hidden chamber. It is the world in which Khufu lived.

heading: WHY BUILD A PYRAMID?
detail: The ancient world is the next chapter
direction: Actual photo holds on Giza as transition; no invented construction footage
spoken_text: To understand how his pyramid was possible, we need to understand why anyone would attempt it at all.
